name: JoBrain
blurb: A job-search command center for discovering roles, tracking applications, and understanding the hiring funnel.
detail: Built with Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Prisma and PostgreSQL/Neon. Includes multi-source discovery, filters, an application pipeline, analytics and a companion autofill extension.

name: HEAVEN
blurb: A developer command center for GitHub activity, workspaces, deployments, meetings, and team integrations.
detail: Next.js App Router with Clerk Organizations, Neon PostgreSQL, GitHub OAuth, Zoom Server-to-Server OAuth, Discord integration and server-side token protection.

name: AI Experience
blurb: A cinematic, scroll-driven visual journey where a custom particle system morphs through multiple scenes.
detail: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, GSAP timelines and Canvas rendering. Includes responsive overlays and reversible scroll-driven states.

name: Nothing
blurb: An immersive product website concept inspired by industrial design, editorial typography, and tactile motion.
detail: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, OGL/WebGL and custom CSS. Built around responsive product presentation and a lightweight visual layer.

name: SelfMusic
blurb: A personal music server with a private library, playlists, streaming, and a device-friendly web player.
detail: Local-first architecture with a SQLite metadata index, account-scoped data, range-based audio streaming, optional FFmpeg transcoding, an installable PWA and remote access options.

name: b1api · Music
blurb: A cinematic, local-first music experience with YouTube search, playback, playlists, likes and history.
detail: Uses YouTube Data API v3 for discovery and the official YouTube IFrame Player for playback. Playlists, likes, history and appearance preferences stay in browser storage.

name: Autofill
blurb: A review-first Chrome extension that fills recognized job application fields without auto-submitting forms.
detail: Manifest V3 extension using chrome.storage.sync, React-controlled input handling, MutationObserver and iframe-aware field detection. Submission remains under the user's control.

name: Brew & Bloom
blurb: A cinematic coffee and dessert experience with product storytelling, an interactive hero, recipes and detail views.
detail: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS and Motion. Built to explore image-led layouts, responsive composition, and considered transitions.

name: myUI
blurb: A personal frontend workbench for testing layouts, typography, transitions, and small interaction details.
detail: React, JavaScript, CSS and Vite. A place to explore component behavior and responsive rhythm before using patterns in larger builds.

name: Bio
blurb: A gothic-inspired interactive bio experience focused on identity, custom visuals, embedded music and motion.
detail: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Framer Motion and CSS; designed as a compact, responsive personal experience.
